mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above the 5-year moving average coincides with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to tightened financing conditions depressing near-term corporate investment.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above its 5-period SMA by at least 0.25 percentage points in the same month.
failure_condition: Over a 60-day window, SPX 20-day forward returns remain positive despite persistent FEDFUNDS above 5-SMA, or the 5-SMA crossing is not confirmed by subsequent monthly FEDFUNDS releases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in unemployment claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 5,000 for two consecutive months coincides with a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as investor sentiment deteriorates on labor market weakness.
failure_condition: In regimes where unemployment is structurally high (>7%), the signal fails to predict negative returns; or 60-day forward returns remain positive despite the two-month high PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) unexpectedly exceeds the prior quarter by more than 0.5%, the S&P 500 20-day forward return turns positive as the Fed is perceived as less restrictive.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > previous_quarter by > 0.5% in the current month.
failure_condition: Over 12 months, the CPIAUCSL surprise never materializes; or the 20-day forward return remains negative despite the inflation spike.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) by double digits, followed by a rebound of at least 3% in the next month, predicts a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates a supply-side shock.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous_month by > -10% in month T, and INDPRO > previous_month by >= 3% in month T+1.
failure_condition: The pattern recurs but SPX 5-day forward returns remain positive; or the rebound in INDPRO is not followed by negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: When the 2-week moving average of RSAFS exceeds 50 million dollars for three consecutive months, it signals excess demand, leading to a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as equities are bid up.
failure_condition: The 3-month RSAFS surge never materializes; or SPX 20-day returns remain negative despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for two consecutive months triggers a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market tightness supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: The UNRATE decline pattern is not observed; or 60-day forward returns remain negative despite the labor signal.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both FEDFUNDS and HOUST (industrial production) by at least 0.25% and 2% respectively in the same month predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to dual contraction in policy rates and supply chain activity.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < previous_month by >= 0.25% AND HOUST < previous_month by >= 2% in the same month.
failure_condition: The interaction never occurs; or when it does, SPX 20-day returns remain positive.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-QE normalization regime (defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for three consecutive months), a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return is expected as investors anticipate policy restraint, regardless of other macro variables.
candidate_trigger: Regime condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for three consecutive months.
failure_condition: The normalization regime is not detected; or the 5-day forward return remains negative despite the regime.
